review_holds: V9 must contain exactly two maximum-tested safely separated connector sets on each translucent ear piece: four sets and eight rectangular tabs total.

Every tab is a plain 22 x 12 x 4 mm rectangle with a 0.3 mm mating gap. The shared tabs begin 1 mm inside the seam plane and moving orange tabs receive a further 0.5 mm interior relief. No wedge, trapezoid, broad base, bridge, clamp, boss, or loose connector is allowed.
Every owner-root Boolean overlap volume must be at least 80 mm3; surface-only or narrow line contact fails generation.
All proposed geometry must remain inside the original exterior occupancy mask from front, left, right, and top.
Each connector set has exactly one common 3.4 mm M3 clearance axis through both tabs: four aligned fastener paths and eight drilled tab holes total.
The two centers on each side must be at least 35 mm apart, and every drilled tab must retain at least 3.5 mm of material from the bore to its nearest tab edge in the local tangent/interior plane.
Use four internal M3 x 16 through-bolts with two 7 mm OD washers and one M3 nyloc nut per bolt. Hardware is specified but not modeled as connector geometry.
Accepted V3 fit geometry, exact ears, source upper heads, eyes, lower-face/rear-cassette ownership, reinforcement direction, C006, and aluminum V0.5 remain unchanged.
No STL, G-code, slicer project, fabrication output, or print release is produced.
